001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.Collections;
006import java.util.List;
007
008/**
009 * Container for aggregated independent failures from converter-level pipeline execution.
010 *
011 * <p>When a pipeline runs multiple commands or stages in parallel, multiple independent failures
012 * can occur simultaneously. This exception wraps all independent failures (末端型のみ) and delivers them
013 * to the main layer as a single exception.
014 *
015 * <p>Each individual failure is a concrete subtype of {@link StreamProcessingException}: {@link
016 * UserInputException}, {@link ExternalTransientException}, {@link ExternalPermanentException}, or
017 * {@link InternalSystemException}.
018 *
019 * <p><strong>Contract: No nested aggregates.</strong> The failures list never contains another
020 * {@code AggregatedStreamProcessingException}. The converter layer must flatten nested aggregates
021 * by extracting their underlying failures.
022 *
023 * <p>Main-layer usage example:
024 *
025 * <pre>{@code
026 * try {
027 *   converter.execute(...);
028 * } catch (StreamProcessingException e) {
029 *   // Safely extract all failures
030 *   List<StreamProcessingException> failures =
031 *       (e instanceof AggregatedStreamProcessingException agg)
032 *         ? agg.getAllFailures()
033 *         : List.of(e);
034 *
035 *   // Prioritize user-input failures for display
036 *   failures.stream()
037 *       .filter(f -> f instanceof UserInputException)
038 *       .findFirst()
039 *       .or(() -> Optional.of(failures.get(0)))
040 *       .ifPresent(f -> showUser(f.getUserMessage()));
041 *
042 *   // Log all failures for diagnosis
043 *   failures.forEach(f -> log.error("pipeline failure", f));
044 * }
045 * }</pre>
046 *
047 * <p>Extends {@link StreamProcessingException}, and therefore {@link IOException}, so that callers
048 * of {@link com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level
049 * failures with a single {@code catch (IOException)} block.
050 *
051 * <p><strong>getUserMessage() behavior:</strong> This class inherits the base {@link
052 * StreamProcessingException#getUserMessage()} (returns {@code DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE}). Per exception
053 * policy §4.3.2, the final behavior of aggregate-level message selection is pending decision in
054 * issue #797. Main-layer code should call {@link #getAllFailures()} to select a representative
055 * failure and use its {@code getUserMessage()} instead of calling this method on the aggregate
056 * itself.
057 *
058 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
059 *
060 * @see StreamProcessingException
061 * @see UserInputException
062 * @see ExternalTransientException
063 * @see ExternalPermanentException
064 * @see InternalSystemException
065 */
066public final class AggregatedStreamProcessingException extends StreamProcessingException {
067  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
068
069  private final List<StreamProcessingException> failures;
070
071  /**
072   * Constructs an AggregatedStreamProcessingException from a list of independent failures.
073   *
074   * <p><strong>Precondition: failures is non-empty and contains no nested
075   * AggregatedStreamProcessingException instances.</strong>
076   *
077   * @param failures non-empty list of independent {@link StreamProcessingException} failures (末端型:
078   *     {@link UserInputException}, {@link ExternalTransientException}, {@link
079   *     ExternalPermanentException}, or {@link InternalSystemException}). Must not contain null
080   *     elements.
081   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if failures is null, empty, contains null elements, or
082   *     contains nested aggregates
083   */
084  public AggregatedStreamProcessingException(List<StreamProcessingException> failures) {
085    super(
086        "Pipeline encountered " + validateAndGetSize(failures) + " failure(s)",
087        failures.isEmpty() ? null : failures.get(0));
088
089    // Validate contents
090    for (int i = 0; i < failures.size(); i++) {
091      StreamProcessingException failure = failures.get(i);
092      if (failure == null) {
093        throw new IllegalArgumentException("failures list contains null element at index " + i);
094      }
095      if (failure instanceof AggregatedStreamProcessingException) {
096        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
097            "nested AggregatedStreamProcessingException not allowed; converter must flatten");
098      }
099    }
100
101    this.failures = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(failures));
102  }
103
104  private static int validateAndGetSize(List<StreamProcessingException> failures) {
105    if (failures == null) {
106      throw new IllegalArgumentException("failures list cannot be null");
107    }
108    if (failures.isEmpty()) {
109      throw new IllegalArgumentException("failures list cannot be empty");
110    }
111    return failures.size();
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Returns all independent failures that occurred during pipeline execution.
116   *
117   * <p><strong>Order preservation:</strong> Failures are listed in command order (upstream to
118   * downstream). Within a single command stage, order among multiple simultaneous failures is
119   * implementation-dependent. For deterministic ordering (e.g., by timestamp), main-layer code
120   * should sort the list.
121   *
122   * <p><strong>Contents:</strong> Never contains {@code AggregatedStreamProcessingException}
123   * (converted by converter layer). Contains only末端型 (concrete notification classes).
124   *
125   * @return unmodifiable list of independent failures (never empty, never contains aggregates)
126   */
127  public List<StreamProcessingException> getAllFailures() {
128    return failures;
129  }
130}
